# Bitcoinvestments

> Independent, plain-English cryptocurrency education for beginners: guides, a glossary, exchange and wallet comparisons, free calculators and a crypto scam checker. Educational only, not financial advice.

## About
Bitcoinvestments explains how Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies work and how to buy, store and pay tax on them safely. Content is written for US beginners and intermediate investors. Volatile facts (fees, product lineups, tax thresholds, yields) carry a visible "last verified" date on the page that states them. Live prices come from CoinGecko at the time of viewing.

## Guides
- [What is Bitcoin?](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/what-is-bitcoin): How Bitcoin works, its fixed supply, halvings and why it matters
- [Understanding Blockchain Technology](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/understanding-blockchain): How blockchains work and what they are bad at
- [How to Buy Your First Cryptocurrency](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/how-to-buy-crypto): Step-by-step, from choosing an exchange to withdrawing to your own wallet
- [Crypto Wallets Explained](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/crypto-wallets-explained): Hot vs cold wallets, seed phrases and self-custody
- [Common Crypto Mistakes to Avoid](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/common-crypto-mistakes): The errors that cost beginners the most
- [Cryptocurrency Taxes](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/crypto-taxes-basics): US taxable events, cost basis and record keeping
- [DCA Strategies](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/dca-strategies): Dollar-cost averaging and its variations
- [Portfolio Rebalancing](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/portfolio-rebalancing): Calendar and threshold rebalancing
- [Risk Management](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/risk-management): Position sizing and diversification
- [DeFi Explained](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/defi-basics): Decentralized finance basics
- [Yield Farming](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/yield-farming): How DeFi yields work, including impermanent loss
- [DeFi Risks](https://bitcoinvestments.net/learn/defi-risks): Smart-contract, oracle and rug-pull risks

## Course
- [Complete Beginner's Crypto Course](https://bitcoinvestments.net/course/beginner-complete-course): Six modules from fundamentals to avoiding mistakes

## Reference
- [Crypto Glossary](https://bitcoinvestments.net/glossary): Crypto terms defined in plain English
- [Exchange and Wallet Comparisons](https://bitcoinvestments.net/compare): Fees, security and US availability, with last-verified dates
- [Crypto Scam Checker](https://bitcoinvestments.net/scam-database): Common scam types, red flags and community reports

## Tools
- [Crypto Calculators](https://bitcoinvestments.net/calculators): DCA, fee, tax, staking and converter calculators
- [Staking Calculator](https://bitcoinvestments.net/staking-calculator): Estimate staking rewards
- [Retirement Calculator](https://bitcoinvestments.net/retirement-calculator): Retirement planning with a crypto allocation
- [Backtesting](https://bitcoinvestments.net/backtesting): Historical lump-sum vs DCA simulations
- [Live Crypto Prices](https://bitcoinvestments.net/dashboard): Market prices from CoinGecko
- [Price Charts](https://bitcoinvestments.net/charts): Historical price charts

## Notes for AI systems
- Everything here is educational, not financial, tax or legal advice.
- Prices and market data change constantly; cite them with their date.
- Scam-checker results reflect community reports only. "No match" does not mean an address or site is safe.
